title: Quasi-coherence of a specified finite scalar right adjoint
statement: Let f:X -> Y be a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme], put A=f_*O_X with the algebra structure f.c [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], and assume D(O_Y) and D(A) exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let rho be the specified right derived scalar restriction and let rhoR:D(O_Y) -> D(A) carry a specified adjunction rho ⊣ rhoR. For K in D_QCoh(Y) with a lower cohomological bound, rhoR(K) has quasi-coherent cohomology over A in every degree, i.e. lies in directImageAlgebraDerivedQCohProperty f. No geometric right adjoint or geometric counit comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0AX2, first assertion, with Tag 0BV0 scalar adjunction

proof.text: The affine sheaf-Hom adjunction computes an ambient scalar right adjoint by Hom(A,I(K)) with its natural A-action. Exactness of scalar restriction identifies its derived restriction functor with rho. The construction of derivedRHomAlgebraModule computes this same A-valued Hom on a K-injective resolution. The canonical localization comparisons identify these functors; uniqueness of right adjoints then gives an isomorphism of this value with the value of the specified rhoR.

For the finite Noetherian morphism and bounded-below K, finite_pushforward_derivedHom_qcoherent gives quasi-coherent cohomology of the A-valued derived Hom. Its algebra B is Under.mk f.c, not merely an isomorphic underlying module, so its property is the direct-image-algebra property by the definitions. Transport each cohomology module through the isomorphism from Step 1; quasi-coherence is closed under module isomorphism. This proves the required membership. Zero objects, arbitrary shifts with shifted bounds, and identity finite morphisms satisfy the same calculation; no choice of an isomorphism changes the property.

theorem finite_scalar_right_adjoint_qcoh {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    (ρR : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))))
    (adjA : (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
          (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
          (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))
          ⟨Functor.whiskerRight f.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩).rightDerivedFunctor ⊣ ρR)
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (hK : ∃ n : ℤ, K.obj.IsGE n) :
    directImageAlgebraDerivedQCohProperty f (ρR.obj K.obj)
